params.name: country
params.description: 2-character ISO code of the country for the bank account that was selected. Currently only the US, CA, UK, DE, and AU are supported.

params.name: paymentType
params.description: Returns the countries that support this Payment Type.

params.name: paymentProvider.subType
params.description: Returns the countries that support this Payment Provider SubType

params.name: enabled
params.description: If true, returns all countries that are currently supported. Default value is true.

items.docs: Returns a list of all available products by country.
